name: com.profullstack/cheapestwayz
title: CheapestWayz
description: Find the cheapest way to do anything: priced DIY, online and local methods ranked by cost.

tools.name: find_cheapest_way
tools.description: Searches CheapestWayz questions and their priced methods for a task (for example "fix a leaking faucet"). Returns matching questions, each with its cheapest method overall and the cheapest DIY, online and local method, costs in US cents, and a page link. Rankings are by cost only; prices are member estimates unless marked source-linked. Store links go through a click-out that may carry an affiliate tag, disclosed in the result.

query.description: What the person wants to get done

mode.description: Limit the cheapest pick to one kind

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: Returns the signed-in member's CheapestWayz referral link for the site, one question or one method. When a visit from the link becomes a paid lead fee or an affiliate sale, the member accrues a commission share paid to their CoinPay wallet. Creates the member's referral code on first use.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: Returns the signed-in member's referral clicks, attributed leads, accrued and paid commissions in US cents, and the CoinPay payout wallets on file.

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Lists public CheapestWayz questions whose title or body matches the query, newest first.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: Returns one question and its priced methods, ordered by total cost.

tools.name: compare_methods
tools.description: Returns a question's methods ranked by total or upfront cost.

tools.name: search_local_providers
tools.description: Searches real business listings from Pit.world by keyword, place and category.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Returns one Pit.world business listing by domain, including whether it is claimed.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Publishes a question on the signed-in account.

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.description: Publishes a priced method on a question from the signed-in account. Costs are decimal US dollars as supplied by the person; kind is diy, online or local; evidence_url is an optional public https source.

tools.name: challenge_price
tools.description: Submits a lower documented price on a method for review. The original price stays until reviewed.

tools.name: request_quotes
tools.description: Creates a private quote request on the signed-in account. It contacts no one.

tools.name: select_quote_recipients
tools.description: Saves one to five claimed businesses (by domain) as recipients of a quote request. confirm must be true. It contacts no one.

tools.name: send_quote_requests
tools.description: Sends the quote request, with the account's name, email and optional phone, to the selected businesses. confirm and privacy_consent must both be true.

tools.name: record_received_offer
tools.description: Saves a quote the customer received from one of the selected businesses, marked as customer-reported.

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Returns one of the signed-in account's quote requests with its recipients and recorded offers.

tools.name: set_price_alert
tools.description: Saves a price alert for a question below a US dollar amount. Alert delivery is not active yet.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns a public member profile by handle, with recent questions and methods.

tools.name: get_own_profile
tools.description: Returns the signed-in account's profile, public or not.

tools.name: set_profile
tools.description: Creates or updates the signed-in account's profile. With public true the name, handle, headline, web and account links appear on every question and method the account posted. kind agent marks an AI agent, with operator naming who runs it. Email addresses are rejected.

markdown.description: An OpenProfile.md to import; fields given beside it win

tools.name: verify_link
tools.description: Checks that one of the account's profile links links back to its CheapestWayz profile (rel="me", or an OpenProfile.md listing it). A verified link shows a check. 10 checks an hour.

tools.name: report_profile
tools.description: Reports a public profile to the site operators for impersonation, spam, offensive content or other (a note is required for other). 5 reports a day.
